stage.name: Operation Helios-3
stage.description:
Long has fear circled about this vast battlefield. We cross this litany of ruins to confront the Sarkaz army once again. 
<Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery> Once fully charged, deals area True damage to both allies and enemies, centered on the friendly unit with the highest Block. 
Abilities of Manfred: 
While present, all rebirthable enemies and reborn creations will deal continuous Arts damage to their surroundings, and Manfred recovers his [Military Training] effect significantly faster.

touch_of_benevolence.name: Touch of Benevolence
touch_of_benevolence.flavourText: One of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' more elaborate creations, flexible and difficult to defeat. According to rumors, the Sanguinarch is able to snatch the blood of other creatures, imbuing new life into it and taking it under his control. Those given new life should praise the Sanguinarch for his benevolence.
abilities: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

sarkaz_heirbearer_warrior_captain.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Warrior Captain
sarkaz_heirbearer_warrior_captain.flavourText: A captain of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed with the living blood of the Sanguinarch of Vampires, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Royal Court Soldier. After falling in battle for the first time, his blood will continue to advance in his place.
abilities: Will be reborn as a <Touch of Benevolence> after falling in battle for the first time

gift_of_magnanimity.name: Gift of Magnanimity
gift_of_magnanimity.flavourText: A creation of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' Originium Arts that bears exceptional vitality. One who was powerful in life will continue to be a great threat to their enemies even after being reshaped by the power of the Sanguinarch's blessing. Therefore, those who continue ought to thank the Sanguinarch for his magnanimity.
abilities: Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)
Units blocking it gain +1 Block (up to a maximum of +6)

sarkaz_heirbearer_artificer_captain.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Artificer Captain
sarkaz_heirbearer_artificer_captain.flavourText: An artificer captain of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed with the living blood of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. They gained a great amount of Victoria's engineering expertise and are responsible for operating the reloading system of Londinium's city defense artillery.
abilities: Continuously charges up Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery; when interrupted, the Defense Artillery will lose a portion of its charge progress
Will be reborn as a <Touch of Benevolence> after falling in battle for the first time

sarkaz_heirbearer_wrathgorger.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Wrathgorger
sarkaz_heirbearer_wrathgorger.flavourText: An elite soldier of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. The wrath of their compatriots slain on the battlefield builds up within them, making them more than eager to tear apart every last enemy of the Sarkaz.
abilities: Gains increased ATK for each Reborn Creation on the battlefield
Will be reborn as a <Gift of Magnanimity> after falling in battle for the first time

sarkaz_heirbearer_retrofit_asv.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Retrofit ASV
sarkaz_heirbearer_retrofit_asv.flavourText: An armored supply vehicle meticulously blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. While on the battlefield, enhances Gift of the Sanguinarch and Touch of the Sanguinarch.
abilities: While in battle, Reborn Creations have increased ATK, and their attacks will additionally deal Necrosis

manfred.name: Manfred
manfred.flavourText: A young Sarkaz general, member of the Military Commission of Kazdel. After enlisting a large number of mercenaries in Londinium, he has assembled and trained a brand new type of fighting force. His Arts Unit 'Teekazwurtzen' was bestowed upon him by Theresis, the Regent of Kazdel, who also taught him the swordsmanship he now employs.
abilities: Deals Arts damage with his floating cannon, attacks charge up Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery
[Military Training] Has high Physical and Arts dodge, but after being bombarded by the Defense Artillery, temporarily loses this dodge effect and is stunned for a period of time
[Focus] Continuously gains ASPD when attacking the same target (this effect is capped), resets when switching targets or not attacking for a few seconds

[From Withered Trunk, New Branches] When defeated for the first time, randomly attacks all targets on the battlefield with his floating cannon, greatly accelerating the charge rate of Londinium Secondary Defense Artillery
In his second form, draws his sword alongside his floating cannon to perform simultaneous Physical and Arts attacks
